title: Wandering Hollows Group Chat Integration
description: Adds a feature which enables players to form group text chats they can message in together.
body:
This mod adds a feature which enables players to form group text chats they can message in together.

These are the commands that the mod includes for players to use this feature:

/joingroup [groupname] [optional password] - This is how you create or join a group 

/leavegroup - This is how you leave a group!

/gtoggle - Toggles between group chat and regular chat! 

/glist - Lists all the group names and whose in them! 

/gwho - While in a group, lists all the people in it!

/ghelp - Lists the commands used in this mod!
